name: earnrate
description: Which credit card earns the most at a store, from yours or every card, and why. Runs on your computer.
long_description:
Ask which credit card to use before you pay. earnrate checks each card against the issuer's own terms and explains its answer: from every card it knows, from the cards you name, or from a wallet you save, where it also tracks the caps you've spent and the categories you've picked.

Your wallet is a file on your computer, listing cards by product (like amex-gold). earnrate never asks for card numbers, expiry dates, security codes or bank logins, and sends nothing anywhere. No affiliate links.

wallet.title: Wallet file
wallet.description: Where earnrate keeps the cards you hold. It's created when you add your first card. The command line version uses the same file.
